title: Reimagining the app experience
summary: Concept exploration for a Boost Mobile app that treats multi-line accounts as a first-class experience.

meta.tools: Figma, Claude Code, Google Stitch, UserZoom, Figma Make

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: How might we improve core usability metrics while engaging multi-line users?
sections.bodyAfter: Something i realized early on, our current app is centered around the single line user with multi line as an afterthought. While we do serve many single line users, a significant number of accounts has more than one line. And yet our services don't account for features managing and engaging these types of users. this is the opportunity

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: Users drop off before completing key tasks or understanding when a submission is successful.
sections.extraTitle: The current app is static and strictly utilitarian.

sections.label: TESTING
sections.title: Progress components for onboarding and account management

sections.label: PROCESS
sections.title: Brainstorming form factors and exploring within the design system.
